name: Altable (Spain)
description: Square flag divided horizontally white over green by a chevron-shaped line edged brown, charged on the green with the crowned municipal arms of Altable (a sword, a cross of Calatrava and a house).
history: Municipal flag of Altable; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Altable arms — sword, cross of Calatrava and house
